note: Paths under benchmarks/results/ are run write targets; that directory is not tracked, so any predecessor artifact named here is unpublished history recorded for provenance, not a file in this repository.
purpose: Repeat the stopped v1 preflight with enough bounded output room to remove the observed 64-token ceiling ambiguity. This is a measurement repair, not score-directed tuning and not C3 optimizer-effectiveness evidence.

observed.basis: The only response consumed all 64 allowed output tokens. The frozen v1 record did not retain finish_reason or the adapter/decoder cause, so it cannot determine whether provider truncation occurred.

frozen_design.schedule: For each seed in order, run baseline then labeled_few_shot; stop immediately on any strict failure.

execution.output_envelope_rationale: The typed answer itself is a one-field JSON object, while the selected free reasoning model consumed the complete 64-token v1 allowance. A fourfold 256-token ceiling remains tightly bounded but separates output-envelope failure from task scoring without changing prompts, rows, arms, k, sampling, seeds, schedule, or decision rules.

required_failure_capture: raw response sha256 and bounded redacted excerpt
logical request and transport attempt counts
same fields in the stopped arm row and campaign summary
stop_rules: malformed typed response or decoder failure

decision_rules.execution_complete: All 48 predeclared responses and all six arm/seed cells complete without a stop-rule violation.
decision_rules.within_task_go: Mean held-out lift is at least 0.03, the exact paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound is above zero, and at least two of three seeds improve.
decision_rules.incomplete: Any missing arm/seed cell or stop-rule violation. An incomplete run is neither an optimizer win nor an optimizer loss.

claim_limits: This single synthetic support-ticket task and single free model cannot establish general LabeledFewShot effectiveness.
There is no independently executed upstream comparator.
This is not the canonical GSM8K and Banking77 optimizer-lift portfolio.
The eight-row test has low statistical resolution.
No result from this campaign may promote a C3 claim or a BEAM-native superiority claim.
